shortDescription.default: File Type Analyser - tree-based file type overview for a SharePoint site collection

longDescription.default: Scans a SharePoint site collection using only SharePoint REST/Search APIs (no Azure AD app registration required) and presents a tree view of webs, document libraries and file types, with counts, approximate sizes and CSV export. Designed to work on large site collections (10+ TB, millions of documents) by aggregating counts through the search index instead of enumerating every file.
